purpose: Prepare one practical operation for active pipeline speed probing and repository root cleanup without another long audit loop.
principle: one operation, one verification set, one commit, one push
phase_style: no new ERA, no new PASS, no random audit loop

A_pipeline_probe.goal: Measure real source-to-readmodel/panel path timing without wallet, trade, provider, or paid API authority.

B_root_cleanup.goal: Keep root clean and move non-current clutter into organized archive paths.
move_to_archive: legacy handoff/start prompts not selected as current

C_docs_cleanup.goal: Stop old docs from competing with live state.
actions: README should point to tk ai and NEXT_CHAT_HANDOFF instead of carrying long stale state
historical sections remain in docs/archive or canonical history, not active startup surface
OKU.md and NEW_CHAT_PROMPT.md should become archive/legacy or redirect stubs only if still tracked

D_plugin_workspace_boundaries.goal: Create visible target boundaries for future work.
actions: plugins directory for future ERA/plugin work
workspace directory for temporary local/staging work

verification_set: python compile for tokenoskobi_kernel.py and boot_workunit files
why_local_required: GitHub contents API can create/update/delete individual files, but safe bulk git mv, local py_compile, tk ai, tk sync, and runtime latency probe require the server workspace.
